visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses wearing a dark grey t-shirt is sitting on a light-colored floor, holding a small metal bowl. A small black and tan Chihuahua sits in front of him. Behind them is a white wire pet playpen and a grey pet carrier. (2) The man points toward a white electronic scale on the floor. The dog walks over and steps onto the scale, standing still while the man watches. (3) The man uses hand gestures to command the dog. He points his finger like a gun, and the dog rolls over onto its side on the floor. (4) The dog performs a series of tricks: sitting, touching the man's hand with its paw, and giving 'high fives' with both front paws. The man rewards the dog with treats from the bowl. (5) The man leads the dog in circles using a treat, and the dog spins clockwise and counter-clockwise. The indoor lighting is bright and even. (6) The dog returns to the scale and then lies down flat on the floor. It performs more high fives while in a prone position before walking back toward the wire playpen. (7) The dog sits obediently for a final close-up shot as animated sparkles appear around its head.
